description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of an exponential back-off configuration. It provides methods to create an instance from a configuration object, and accessor methods for configuration parameters such as min/max durations, a random factor, and a corrupted receive timeout.

classes.name: DefaultExponentialBackOffConfig
classes.description: An immutable Java class implementing the ExponentialBackOffConfig interface, representing configuration for exponential back-off strategies, including min/max durations, randomness factor, and timeout.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultExponentialBackOffConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum Duration for back-off.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum Duration for back-off.

methods.name: getRandomFactor
methods.description: Returns the randomness factor used in calculations.

methods.name: getCorruptedReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration associated with corrupted receive scenarios.
